title: Rapid Effects of a Biofield Patch on Antioxidant Status and Cellular Energy
official: Rapid Effects of a Biofield Patch on Antioxidant Status and Cellular Energy
summary: The goal for this clinical proof-of-concept study is to compare an active biofield skin patch to a placebo patch on antioxidant function and mitochondrial function. A double-blind, placebo-controlled cross-over study design will be used.
